headline: South Africa Explores New Export Routes Following US AGOA Decision
summary: South Africa is seeking to expand trade relationships with India, the European Union, China, and other African nations after the United States moved to end its preferential trade benefits under AGOA.
why: The African Growth and Opportunity Act provides duty-free access to the U.S. market for qualifying Sub-Saharan African nations, making policy shifts critical for regional exporters.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: The loss of preferential trade access under AGOA forces exporters to restructure trade routes and markets.
